# duplicated-constants (KDU001)

**Duplicated constants**

This rule is enabled by default.

## What it does

Finds constants and literal containers whose value is also defined in another project module.

## Why is this bad?

Duplicated constants drift apart when one copy changes, and repeated values hide the shared meaning they represent.

## Options

Configured in `[tool.konform.lint.duplicated-constants]`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min-string-length` | `integer` | 4 | Minimum string length compared across different names. |
| `ignore-names` | `string list` | ["pytestmark"] | Names excluded from duplicate checks. |
| `paths` | `string list` | [] | Additional project paths collected during partial runs. |
| `level` | `string` | "warning" | Violation level: warning or error. |

## Suppression

```python
x = 1  # noqa: KDU001
x = 1  # noqa: KDU  (every KDU* rule)
```
